'''Phelly''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] on the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] ''[[Freedom]]''. He participated in the [[Battle of Thyferra]] against [[Ysanne Isard]]'s Thyferran forces.<ref name="bacta" />
